rationale: The proposition is a faithful logical packaging of Definition 2.7.5's sub-exponential classification and display (2.21): finite displayed psi_1 gauge is equivalent to satisfying one of Proposition 2.7.1(a)-(d). The local definitions reproduce all four properties, positivity, probability-space context, absolute values, exponential constants, and the one-point threshold 2. The book's adjacent K_3/property-3 prose is internally inconsistent with its own display and property labels; this is recorded without repair. Because the audited theorem concerns only finiteness and keeps the two predicates distinct, the absolute-factor equivalence makes that source defect immaterial to both implication directions, though it would matter for any claim of exact equality of optimal parameters.
